items.label: Offices held
items.text: Elected to the U.S. House from California's 29th Congressional District in 2024 (AP race call). Previously a member of the California State Assembly; her campaign announced the congressional run as Assemblywoman Luz Rivas (years of Assembly service not stated in the sources seen). (sources: Associated Press (via SooToday) https://sootoday.com/world-news/ap-race-call-democrat-luz-rivas-wins-election-to-us-house-in-californias-29th-congressional-district-9765895 [search summary, secondary]; Luz Rivas for Congress (campaign site) https://www.luzforcongress.com/news/assemblywoman-luz-rivas-announces-candidacy-for-california-s-29th-congressional-district [search summary, primary])
